scope: Local audit of K2 normative traceability; no legal-force/current-edition verification

primarySource.document: СН РК 4.01-03-2013* «Водоотведение. Наружные сети и сооружения»

statusLegend.implemented-tested: Rule is transcribed, used by product logic, and has a direct behavioral test
statusLegend.partial: Some logic/tests exist, but the complete normative condition is not enforced
statusLegend.registry-only: Rule exists in NORM_REGISTRY but has no product enforcement
statusLegend.missing: Confirmed source requirement has no NORM_REGISTRY entry and no implementation
statusLegend.manual-input: Product records a user/engineer value but cannot derive or verify it from the supplied norms

findings.implementation: engine/src/norms/storm-runoff.ts implements formulas 5.8-5.13, Tables 5.9-5.12, strict table ranges, interpolation provenance and guarded ambiguous cases; GravitySection consumes verified drainage.stormCatchments and treats manual L/s only as draft input
findings.gap: The formula pipeline is implemented and final issue is blocked for unverified catchments, but q20 still requires a verified site-specific climatology/map interpretation and catchments over 50 ha need explicit partial-basin calculations
Additional inflow and the 0.95-height verification are not calculated; registry sourcePage points only to page 34 although 0.95 is on page 35
Lookup/interpolation is tested but not used by the end-to-end gravity flow accumulation
Material-specific equivalent roughness values from Table 5.18 are stored but the gravity solver uses n1 rather than selecting the full table by material

findings.implementation: engine/src/norms/sewer.ts:minVelocityMps; engine/src/norms/gravity.ts:designGravitySegment and solveGravityNetwork; frontend passes the unique verified catchment P
findings.gap: Resolved: 0.6 m/s is enabled only for a confirmed P = 0.33 year; otherwise the Table 5.19 diameter value applies
No dedicated issue is raised for the lower end of the stated 7-10 m/s storm range; 10 m/s is used as the cap
The registry cites only page 39 although its requirement also includes the exception printed on page 40
Only 150/200 mm fixed values are implemented; >200 mm is intentionally returned as null and then sized from hydraulic criteria, without implementing referenced source [1]

findings.implementation: Table JSON is exported from engine/src/norms/sewer.ts but no decision function or network use exists
findings.gap: Open storm channels/lots are not designed or checked

findings.implementation: engine/src/norms/sewer.ts:sewerBurialDepthConstraints/minSewerInvertDepthM; engine/src/norms/gravity.ts:computeGravityProfile; frontend source verification; working-drawing FREEZING_DEPTH_UNVERIFIED gate
findings.gap: Resolved in code: invert frost depth and crown cover are separate, diameter is added exactly once, and final issue requires a positive sourced explicitly verified freezing depth
Lookup is tested but route/profile generation does not insert or audit manholes at the required spacing

findings.implementation: None; a separate user-supplied manhole catalogue is required for final sheets
findings.gap: No normative chamber sizing and no automatic drop-well decision
Lookup is tested but the product does not place inlets, calculate gutter-flow width, or enforce the stated applicability condition
Connection length <=40 m, no more than one intermediate inlet, slope 0.02 and diameter >=200 mm are not enforced

findings.implementation: The constrained router handles geometric obstacles and penalties, but does not cite or enforce these three clauses
findings.gap: No 5D/10 m parallel-spacing audit, no above-ground mode audit, and no >=90 degree junction rule

findings.implementation: engine/src/working-drawings.ts requires structured crossing cards and requiredClearanceM; engine/src/constrained-route.ts detects/penalizes crossings
findings.gap: Clause 7.1.1 delegates exact plan/intersection clearances to other standards not present in the supplied set; the application cannot derive requiredClearanceM and only checks that it was entered
Tests mostly assert strings, page count and A3 size; they do not verify every required plan annotation, profile field, line weight, scale or visual layout

findings.document: ГОСТ Р 21.101-2020 (methodological sample, not confirmed RK authority)
findings.gap: DXF uses a simplified A4 landscape frame/title block rather than a geometrically verified Form 3; registry sourcePage=41 omits pages 12 and 14 used by its requirement
Generated table has 6 columns and omits Supplier, Mass per unit and Notes; tests do not assert the full Form 1 schema
Specification rows are generated from calculated pipes and structures, but exact product codes remain section-level rather than verified catalogue positions

findings.clause: Annexes А, В, Г, Е, Ж
findings.gap: Forms are generated and tested structurally, but act.pressureTest points only to page 111 while its requirement combines three forms on pages 111/115/117

findings.clause: Section 5; Annexes Б, В, Г, Д; Form Ф-2
findings.gap: Single-page citation fields do not represent multi-page requirements; tests validate selected labels/pages rather than completeness against all form fields

targetedTestRun.command: vitest run normregistry, sewer, gravity, forms and export suites in one thread
targetedTestRun.interpretation: Current implementation is internally consistent with its own expected values; this is not proof of full K2 normative compliance
